implementation: Ready local provider reads remain direct. Missing/corrupt native identities enter the existing foreground scheduler only for the same native provider owner and an exact granted shared event/entity reference. Private observations repair only local availability; no remote waiter. Independent providers and typed legacy descriptors keep their own unavailable behavior; legacy string hydration is unchanged.

Captured session content event/entity, branch and checkout generation fence wait registration, Engine/SQL waiting and completion. Identical bytes under a new event stale the old waiter. Each grant generation and sharing is rechecked through the existing metadata authority. Read FileRevision.generation is the selected workspace view generation, not save-operation ownership. Existing durable local workspace UUID is lazily allocated off Engine and reused by later native saves/reopen without schema changes.

Each wait covers <=1MiB under one RAII DemandLease, rearming only for a new missing key or a verified index contradicted by physical data. Only that key is invalidated; receipts/permissions unchanged. Independent waiters cancel separately and installations retain existing provider/object joining. Public caller contexts weak-link worker stop without cancelling the caller parent; adapters additionally check their fence during Engine and SQL polling.

A global64 native-wait permit and adapter slots are acquired before secondary connection/demand allocation. Ready ranges need no slot. One zero-wait secondary per accepted wait, idle pool<=8, previous busy timeout restored on return. New connection applies zero timeout before initial metadata read; SQL busy retries own deadline/cancel/fence instead of waiting5s internally. No new threads or inline network fallback. Arbitrary blocking provider/OS I/O/fsync remains outside hard interruption guarantees.

Legacy round capacity refusal could race its own credit return and then see no pending sink work, incorrectly yielding a still-incomplete round. A process-local credit epoch advances after returned proofs drop and before retiring count reaches0; a changed epoch across refusal/pending makes the runner retry once before normal fairness yield.
